newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Tutu to see U.S. cancer expert.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Tutu to see U.S. cancer expert.

text.p: South African Nobel peace laureate Archbishop Desmond Tutu said on Wednesday he would consult a U.S. prostate cancer expert during a visit to the United States starting on Saturday.
South African surgeons removed Tutu's cancerous prostate gland earlier this year and the archbishop said in a state radio interview on Wednesday the disease appeared to have been contained.
But he said he had decided to take up an invitation to see an American cancer specialist during his trip to the United States.

"People are offering, saying 'please come to Sloan-Kettering', which is regarded I think as the number one cancer institute, and for prostate cancer they do say this person in Baltimore is the number one," Tutu said.
Tutu has retired as archbishop of Cape Town but is chairman of South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission which is trying to lift the veil on apartheid-era human rights abuses.
